The corroboration / maturity gate (Stage-0 SS11)

Source: R/validation.R
gate_corroboration.Rd

Decides whether a lens of a given maturity tier may corroborate the fourth opinion, and at what weight discount. A koine-first lens (koine-implemented-validated) may corroborate only when validation evidence is on record (validation_ref); without it the lens is treated as experimental and may not corroborate — an unvalidated first-mover is never silently trusted (open-arms correctness, SS6/SS11).

Usage

gate_corroboration(maturity_tier, validation_ref = NULL)

Arguments

maturity_tier

One of "reference-validated", "koine-implemented-validated", "experimental".

validation_ref

Optional identifier of the validation evidence (e.g. a ledger cairn id). Required to back the koine-implemented-validated tier.

Value

A list with effective_tier, may_corroborate (logical), and discount (1 reference-validated, 0.5 koine-validated, 0 experimental).

Examples

gate_corroboration("reference-validated")
#> $effective_tier
#> [1] "reference-validated"
#> 
#> $may_corroborate
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $discount
#> [1] 1
#> 
gate_corroboration("koine-implemented-validated", validation_ref = "cairn-1")
#> $effective_tier
#> [1] "koine-implemented-validated"
#> 
#> $may_corroborate
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $discount
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
gate_corroboration("koine-implemented-validated") # unbacked -> experimental
#> $effective_tier
#> [1] "experimental"
#> 
#> $may_corroborate
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $discount
#> [1] 0
#>
